name: release-agent-amendment-decision
body: `requirements.stakeholder.agent-suite-maintainer` contains `requirements.requirement.agent-builder-optional-release-agent` (feature `agent-builder-roster-cleanup`), which drives `domain.entity.release-agent-flow` (kind entity). The entity is a child of `domain.group.agent-roster` alongside `generated-agent-set`, `distributed-agent-set`, and `agent-file-migration`, and is `realised-by` `solution.component.agent-builder-prompt`, `solution.component.codebase-navigator-prompt`, `solution.component.agent-roster-docs`, and `solution.component.push-tag-policy-surfaces`. `requirements.constraint.push-tag-release-agent-carve-out` is the scoped statement of the push/tag law, and the release-agent is its carve-out.
